reviews.text:
They have a nice work system set up - Fluid and flowing smoothly. Constantly busy with very little wait time.  Receptionist greeted us with a smile!  Technicians and the doctor had smiles throughout our visit.

Positive energy!  Good Vibes!
I've used this veterinarian for many years. They are an excellent clinic. I will continue to use them

I have been taking my dogs here for years. The staff and doctors are always very kind and their services are reasonably priced. Look no further if you are looking for a vet to take care of your fur babies.

I have been taking my dogs, all of my dogs here for 20 years.  Dr. Cooper is our favorite and we always make an effort to schedule our appointments with her.  She has always taken wonderful care of my puppies and the staff is great.

Updated review:  They need to do better in answering their phone!  Their customer service has steadily declined because it is so hard to get a hold of them. Seriously, leaving a message is so 1998! I hope they get their act together.

Excellent vet care. I've been taking my pets here for over 15 years. First my cat and now my dog. They actually care about pets.
Not only is the service excellent but their prices are always hundreds less than quotes I hear from others.
Everyone was wonderful at the office from the front to the back - we are so sad that we moved out of the area! I recommend them any chance I get.
Friendly staff and veterinarian! We have a very old dog-he was treated carefully and competently for an ear infection. The fee was very reasonable for an ear cleaning, lab test and medication!

I had been searching for a vet who charges reasonably for a neuter for my dog. My regular vet quoted me $1,500, and my friend said that was exorbitant. He recommended some low cost high volume places but when I researched those places, the reviews were generally bad and I just felt uncomfortable having my dog neutered there. Thankfully my daughter found Rancho Mesa Animal Hospital who does low cost spay and neuter.

Before the neuter, they required a full exam for my dog. Dr McCroskey examined my dog and she was most gentle and patient with him (he was highly anxious). She made me feel comfortable and put me at ease too.

The front desk staff are also very friendly and kind and answered all my concerns. When we brought our dog in on the day of the surgery, the staff carried and cuddled him. When we went to pick him up, they were patient and efficient. After seeing to all the paperwork, he was carried out to us.

We couldn’t be happier with the surgery by Dr Cooper and the service that we have received so far.

We don’t particularly fancy the location of the clinic (surrounded by car repair workshops), but will be switching vets for our two dogs to Rancho Mesa Animal Hospital.

This vet's office is amazing! I've never had a bad experience. They are so nice and thorough and their prices are so reasonable! They never upcharge or try and get you to agree to something that you don't need. They are so compassionate and really listen to what you are saying. You can really trust them! I highly recommend them!!

The veterinarian was very nice and they did their best for Homer, my cat who had cancer. It was a weird situation where we had to rely on the veterinarian’s gut, since my cat was rapidly declining and the test results kept getting delayed. Us relying on the vet’s gut kept Homer from suffering for days, since we had to put him down. I really appreciate the accuracy and experience the vet had. They were very willing to put up with my constant phone calls when my cat was alive.  She also called us a few days later to check on us.

Excellent experience!
I couldn't ask for more for my dog Toby.
Definitely my new vet, from now on.

I’ve been taking my dogs and cats here for many years. They always provided excellent care for a reasonable fee but my last visit was a disappointment. Instead of the vet coming into the exam room, my dogs were taken back to be examined …

We’ve been coming here for as long as I can remember. My cat is 16 and in wonderful health. I’ve also had to put a pet down here and they were very sweet and sympathetic. They are flexible in their availability and easy to schedule with. Would recommend to any pet owner!
We’ve been bringing our pups here for years and love all of the different veterinarians and vet techs. They have taken wonderful care of our animals throughout the years.
